article.story: CEDAR FALLS, Iowa -- — Greyson Uelmen’s 19 points helped Northern Iowa defeat Lindenwood 81-74 on Tuesday. Uelmen also had eight assists for the Panthers (3-3). Carson Vis scored 15 points, shooting 6 for 12, including 2 for 5 from beyond the arc. Geon Hutchins had 12 points and shot 4 of 5 from the field and 4 of 7 from the free-throw line. Marsai Mason finished with 18 points for the Lions (2-4). Lindenwood also got 17 points from Dom Clay. Shamiere Green also had nine points, eight rebounds and two steals. Northern Iowa led Lindenwood at the half, 33-32. The Panthers took the lead for good with 10:24 left in the second half on a free throw from Isaiah Johnson-Arigu to make it 51-50. Up next Up next for Northern Iowa is a Monday matchup with Davidson, and Lindenwood squares off against New Haven on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
